Perfect! Now I have comprehensive market research data. Let me compile this into a detailed comparison table for you:

## 📊 Complete 4K Monitor Market Research Report (UK 2026)

### Key Finding for Your Budget:
You have **excellent options** under £700. The AOC U27B3A at just **£129-139** is a standout value, and you can easily fit **dual 4K monitors** within your budget!

---

### **4K MONITORS COMPARISON TABLE**

| Brand | Model | UK Price | Screen Size | Resolution | Panel Type | Refresh Rate | Key Features | Best For |
|-------|-------|----------|------------|-----------|-----------|--------------|-------------|----------|
| **AOC** | U27B3A | **£129-139** | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | IPS | 60Hz | HDR10, Adaptive-Sync, Built-in speakers, 4ms response | Budget Coding |
| **BenQ** | EW2780U | **£406-450** | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | IPS | 60Hz | HDR, Eye Care, USB-C 60W, Built-in speakers | Home Office/Entertainment |
| **Dell** | UltraSharp U2725QE | **£518-574** | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | IPS Black | 120Hz | Thunderbolt 4 Hub, 140W charging, DisplayHDR 600, Professional grade | Professional/Coding |
| **ASUS** | ProArt PA279CDV | **~£600-700** (estimated) | 26.5" | 4K (3840×2160) | QD-OLED | 120Hz | Factory calibrated (ΔE<1.5), 99% DCI-P3, 1000-nit peak, 96W USB-C | Creative Professionals |
| **Dell** | Alienware AW2725Q | **~£780-900** (estimated) | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | QD-OLED | 240Hz | Gaming-focused, 0.03ms response, DisplayHDR 400 | Gaming/High Performance |
| **Samsung** | Odyssey G8 (27") | **~£799** (estimated) | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | QD-OLED | 240Hz | 0.03ms response, Glare Free, High brightness | Gaming |
| **LG** | 27UL550P | **£299-349** (estimated) | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | IPS | 60Hz | HDR10, AMD FreeSync, Professional UltraFine | Professional Work |
| **LG** | 27UP550-W | **£350-400** (estimated) | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | IPS | 60Hz | HDR10, VESA DisplayHDR 400 | Professional Work |
| **LG** | UltraGear GX7 (27GX790B) | **£899** | 27" | 4K (3840×2160) | OLED | 540Hz (QHD mode) | Dual-mode gaming, Tandem RGB, 1500 nits peak | Competitive Gaming |

---

### 💡 **RECOMMENDATIONS FOR YOUR NEEDS**

#### **Best Value - Single Monitor (Coding Focus)**
- **AOC U27B3A** at **£129-139**
  - Genuine 4K IPS panel
  - Perfect for coding with sharp detail
  - **Save £560+ of your budget!**

#### **Best Dual Monitor Setup (Coding + Productivity)**
- **Option 1: Two AOC U27B3A** = **~£260-280 total** ✅ Perfect for dual-monitor coding setup
- **Option 2: AOC U27B3A + BenQ EW2780U** = **~£530-590** (Premium dual setup with better features)

#### **Best Single Premium Monitor (Best Specs)**
- **Dell UltraSharp U2725QE** at **£518-574**
  - Professional-grade IPS Black panel
  - Thunderbolt 4 hub (charges laptop + high-speed data)
  - 120Hz refresh rate (smooth scrolling for coding)
  - DisplayHDR 600 certification
  - **Ideal single monitor for coding professionals**

#### **Best for Future-Proofing (Coding + Creative Work)**
- **ASUS ProArt PA279CDV** at **~£600-700**
  - QD-OLED technology (superior blacks & colors)
  - Professional color accuracy (ΔE<1.5)
  - 1000-nit peak brightness
  - 120Hz refresh rate

---

### 📋 **MY TOP 3 RECOMMENDATIONS FOR YOUR SITUATION**

1. **Best Budget Option: Two AOC U27B3A Monitors**
   - Price: ~£280 total (saving £420!)
   - Perfect for dual-monitor coding workspace
   - Genuine 4K on both displays

2. **Best Single Monitor: Dell UltraSharp U2725QE**
   - Price: ~£545 average
   - Thunderbolt 4 means one cable for everything
   - Professional build quality
   - Excellent for coding with 120Hz smoothness

3. **Premium Dual Setup: AOC U27B3A + BenQ EW2780U**
   - Price: ~£530-590 total
   - Combines value + features
   - Great for productivity

---

---

### ✅ **KEY TAKEAWAYS**

- **Your budget of £700 is EXCELLENT** for 4K monitors in 2026
- **Dual 4K is absolutely doable** - Two AOC monitors for under £300
- **For coding specifically**, the Dell U2725QE's Thunderbolt hub + 120Hz is ideal for a professional single setup
- **Prices have become very competitive** - True 4K is accessible at £129+
- **Best value proposition**: AOC U27B3A is nearly 1/5th the price of premium models while delivering genuine 4K quality
